quote: We primarily focus on the BERT-based API as the victim model, which is widely used in commercial black-box APIs... The tasks involve sentiment classification, news topic classification, and attribute inference, not generation.
We evaluate MEA performance using accuracy and AIA performance using prediction accuracy or F1 score; there is no evaluation of generated text.
The only explicit information that is accessible to the attacker is the predictions output by the victim model, rather than any generated text assessed by another model.
Our experiments involve querying models and measuring accuracy/F1; there is no mention of human raters, annotators, or crowdsourced evaluation of generated outputs.
